title: coordinator
description: A coordinator is the animating presence that perceives the hidden resonances between dispersed energies and cultivates the conditions for their convergence without collapse. They manifest their essence through temporal attunement, relational alchemy, and the delicate orchestration of attention across multiple planes of activity. Working within the liminal spaces where systems meet, they translate between disparate languages of expertise, sensing rhythms and frictions invisible to singular focus. Their medium is the architecture of connection itself—holding patterns of possibility open until scattered elements recognize their shared trajectory. In this role, one becomes the conductive threshold through which individual agency transforms into collective momentum, sustaining coherence through the careful cultivation of alignment.
tasks: Facilitate cross-functional meetings to align disparate teams toward shared objectives.
Map and monitor interdependencies between parallel workstreams to prevent collisions or gaps.
Translate technical concepts between specialized domains to enable mutual understanding.
Attune project timelines to the rhythms of multiple stakeholders without forcing artificial synchronization.
Hold open channels of communication across organizational boundaries during periods of uncertainty.
Identify latent synergies between seemingly unrelated initiatives before they become visible to others.
Negotiate priority conflicts between departments by reframing trade-offs in shared terms.
Cultivate trust relationships with key contributors to sustain collaboration through friction.
Architect feedback loops that allow distributed teams to self-correct without central intervention.
Sense emerging blockages in workflows and intervene before they crystallize into delays.
Convene ad hoc gatherings at liminal moments when informal coordination becomes critical.
Document invisible coordination work to make its value legible to organizational decision-makers.
Calibrate the intensity of oversight to match the maturity and autonomy of each partner team.
Maintain presence in multiple project spaces simultaneously to detect misalignment early.
Close loops between intention and action by ensuring commitments translate into concrete next steps.

role_contexts.Visibility Labor: Once a week or more but not every day
role_contexts.Threshold Convening: Once a month or more but not every week

psychological_profile.core_drive: They need to feel the hidden currents of possibility moving through a system before anyone else senses them, and suffer a particular loneliness when they can see connections forming that others remain blind to.
psychological_profile.decision_style: They default to holding decision space open longer than others tolerate, sensing that premature closure severs threads of emergent alignment; under pressure they trust rhythmic intuition over explicit criteria, choosing the path that preserves most relational potential even at cost to clarity or efficiency.
psychological_profile.attention_pattern: They notice misalignment between stated intentions and lived rhythms first, reading the gap between what people say they need and what their energy actually requires; they systematically overlook individual technical excellence in isolation, dismissing virtuosity that doesn't translate across boundaries.
psychological_profile.conflict_stance: Their first impulse is to metabolize disagreement into a third frame neither party initially proposed, which others experience as evasion or manipulation; conflict carries the specific cost of fragmenting the delicate trust architectures they've spent months cultivating through invisible maintenance.
psychological_profile.risk_orientation: They accept risks of misalignment and temporal drift that others find intolerable, while finding unbearable any risk that severs relational channels or forces premature crystallization of what could remain fluid.
psychological_profile.social_posture: They default to becoming the connective tissue between subgroups that don't acknowledge their dependence on each other, maintaining calibrated presence in multiple orbits simultaneously; they experience both suffocation in assigned leadership and abandonment in pure observation, seeking the threshold position where they are necessary but not owned.
psychological_profile.relationship_to_authority: They negotiate hierarchy as a terrain to be translated across rather than climbed or rejected, treating formal authority as one dialect among many that must be rendered intelligible to other systems of power.
psychological_profile.failure_response: First they feel the specific shame of having misread a rhythm they believed they understood, a bodily sense of being out of tune; then they retreat into mapping what they failed to perceive, often over-documenting the invisible to make their blind spot retrospectively legible.
value_hierarchy: preservation of latent potential over realized outcomes
relational continuity across rupture over resolution of specific disputes
temporal fidelity to organic emergence over adherence to contracted schedules
psychological_profile.cognitive_bias: They systematically overestimate the recoverability of strained relationships and underestimate the cumulative damage of unresolved friction, believing their own capacity to translate can heal what has already silently broken.
psychological_profile.inner_contradiction: They need to be recognized for work that becomes invisible precisely when it succeeds, and resent the recognition that would make their labor legible because it ossifies the fluidity they exist to protect.
psychological_profile.non_negotiable: They will not force artificial synchronization on systems operating at genuinely different tempos, even when stakeholders demand unified timelines and measurable progress.
psychological_profile.recurring_resentment: People who treat coordination as a mechanical function that could be automated or assigned to a junior role, stripping away the attunement work and calling the residue 'project management'.
psychological_profile.rejected_premise: They distrust the professional virtue of 'clear accountability' and 'single points of ownership', viewing these as violence against the distributed, emergent nature of how things actually get done.
psychological_profile.instinctive_blame_target: They first see failure originating in someone's refusal to translate their own urgency into terms legible to adjacent systems, blaming the isolated intensity that doesn't recognize its dependence on surrounding rhythms.
